# Operations

Every capability, as it appears on HTTP, MCP and the CLI.

## `token_create`

Create an API token and show it once. The `cli` token is also saved for the CLI.

| Surface | Usage |
|---|---|
| HTTP | not on HTTP |
| MCP | not on MCP |
| CLI | `roomba-kit token create [OPTIONS] NAME` (CLI only) |

**Parameters**

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | str | yes |  | Token name, e.g. `cli` or `home-assistant` |

**Result**

Type: `TokenCreated`

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | str | yes |  |
| `token` | str | yes | The plaintext token. Shown once; store it now. |

## `token_list`

List API tokens: name, created and last used. Token values are never shown.

| Surface | Usage |
|---|---|
| HTTP | not on HTTP |
| MCP | not on MCP |
| CLI | `roomba-kit token list [OPTIONS]` (CLI only) |

**Parameters**

_No fields._

**Result**

Type: `list[TokenRecord]`

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | str | yes |  |
| `created_at` | datetime | yes |  |
| `last_used_at` | datetime \| None | no |  |

## `token_revoke`

Revoke an API token. The service rejects it from its next request.

| Surface | Usage |
|---|---|
| HTTP | not on HTTP |
| MCP | not on MCP |
| CLI | `roomba-kit token revoke [OPTIONS] NAME` (CLI only) |

**Parameters**

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | str | yes |  | Token name, e.g. `cli` or `home-assistant` |

**Result**

Type: `TokenRevoked`

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | str | yes |  |
| `revoked` | bool | yes |  |
